g.text: Catalog 2 of 3 · Management: product, images and variants
All these routes go through the same sieve:
The ceiling is declared in the contract
so the front can reject the file
Stores the row with its UUIDv7
The first image by UUIDv7 order
[It's the last image of an active product]
An active product can't be left without an image.
Upload the replacement first, or disable the product
Inserts the SKU with its stock
its active payment link: a link
can't sell at a stale price
